verse.verse_2: Nay, they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: "This is a strange thing!"
verse.verse_3: "When we are dead and have become dust. (Shall we be resurrected) That is a far return."
verse.verse_4: We know that which the earth takes of them, and with Us is a Book preserved.
verse.verse_5: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a Marij state.
verse.verse_6: Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no Furuj in it
verse.verse_7: And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon Rawasi standing firm, and We planted in it every lovely (Bahij) pair.
verse.verse_8: An insight and a Reminder for every servant who turns to Allah in repentance.
verse.verse_9: And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith Jannat and grain that are reaped.
verse.verse_10: And date palms Basiqat, with arranged clusters.
verse.verse_11: A provision for the servants. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the Resurrection.
verse.verse_12: Denied before them the people of Nuh, and the Dwellers of Rass, and Thamud,
verse.verse_13: And `Ad, and Fir`awn, and the brethren of Lut,
verse.verse_14: And the Dwellers of Al-Aykah, and the people of Tubba`. Everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My threat took effect.
verse.verse_15: Were We then tired with the first creation Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation.
verse.verse_16: And indeed We have created man, and We know what his self whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
verse.verse_17: (Remember) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
verse.verse_18: Not a word does he (or she) utter but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it).
verse.verse_19: And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding!"
verse.verse_20: And the Trumpet will be blown -- that will be the Day of the threat.
verse.verse_21: And every person will come forth along with a Sa'iq and a Shahid.
verse.verse_22: (It will be said to the sinners): "Indeed you were heedless of this. Now We have removed from you, your covering, and sharp is your sight this Day!"
verse.verse_23: And his companion (angel) will say: "Here is (his record) ready with me!"
verse.verse_24: (Allah will say to the angels:) "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever"
verse.verse_26: "Who set up another god with Allah. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment."
verse.verse_27: His companion (devil) will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, but he was himself in error far astray."
verse.verse_28: (Allah) will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat."
verse.verse_29: "The sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants."
verse.verse_30: On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled" It will say: "Are there any more"
verse.verse_31: And Paradise will be Uzlifat to those who had Taqwa, not far off.
verse.verse_32: (It will be said): "This is what you were promised -- (it is) for those returning in sincere repentance, and Hafiz."
verse.verse_33: "Who feared Ar-Rahman unseen and brought a heart turned in repentance."
verse.verse_34: "Enter you therein in peace and security -- this is a Day of eternal life!"
verse.verse_35: There they will have all that they desire -- and We have more.
verse.verse_36: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And they went about the land! Could they find any place of refuge
verse.verse_37: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.
verse.verse_38: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.
verse.verse_39: So bear with patience all that they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
verse.verse_40: And during a part of the night (also) glorify His praises and (so likewise) after the prostrations.
verse.verse_41: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.
verse.verse_42: The Day when they will hear As-Sayhah in truth, that will be the Day of coming out.
verse.verse_43: Verily, it is We Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.
verse.verse_44: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.
verse.verse_45: We know best what they say. And you are not the one to force them. But warn by the Qur'an; him who fears My threat.
